  Qaid zindaaṅ meiṅ chhoti si ek hai qaidan
  Ek hai qaidan
  Jaane kab ho ke riha jaayegi wo apne watan
  Ek hai qaidan

  1
  Dur Baba se hui bhaiya se bhi dur hui
  Siskiyaaṅ le na sake kitni wo majbur hui
  Khun kaanoṅ se rawaaṅ haathoṅ meiṅ hai us ke rasan
  Ek hai qaidan

  2
  Jab se bichhri hai wo Baba se kahaaṅ soti hai
  Yaad zindaan meiṅ Baba ko kar ke roti hai
  Kab use sone bhala deti hai pattharoṅ ki chubhan
  Ek hai qaidan

  3
  Puchhti rehti hai Sajjad se kab jaauṅ gi ghar
  Karna ehsaan ye mujh par bhai mar jaauṅ agar
  Jahaaṅ Asghar hai wahaaṅ karna mujhe bhai dafn
  Ek hai qaidan

  4
  Jab wo zindaaṅ ki diwaaroṅ se takraati hai
  Sirf zanjir ke rone ki sada aati hai
  Roye zindaan use roye use charkh-e-kohan
  Ek hai qaidan

  5
  Chhaaya zindaan meiṅ hai gor andhera haaye
  Aur zindaaṅ ke andheroṅ meiṅ wo dar dar jaaye
  Haaye Khurshid thi na aaye na dar us ko kiran
  Ek hai qaidan

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

path = Path(\"src/data/lyrics/qaid-zindaan-mein.md\")
original = path.read_bytes().decode(\"utf-8\")
header, roman, source = original.split(\"romanLyrics: |-\\n\", 1)[0], *original.split(\"romanLyrics: |-\\n\", 1)[1].split(\"\\n---\\n\", 1)
roman = roman.replace(\"si ek hai\", \"si ik hai\").replace(\"Ek hai qaidan\", \"Ik hai qaidan\")
roman = roman.replace(\"jaayegi\", \"jaaye gi\")
assert roman.splitlines().count(\"  Ik hai qaidan\") == 7
digits = str.maketrans(\"۱۲۳۴۵\", \"12345\")
roman_blocks = roman.strip().split(\"\\n\\n\")
source_blocks = source.strip().split(\"\\n\\n\")
assert len(roman_blocks) == len(source_blocks) == 6
for i, (r, s) in enumerate(zip(roman_blocks, source_blocks)):
    r_lines, s_lines = r.splitlines(), s.splitlines()
    assert len(r_lines) == len(s_lines) == 4 + bool(i)
    if i:
        assert r_lines[0].strip() == s_lines[0].translate(digits) == str(i)
assert all(c.isascii() or c in \"ṅṄ\" for c in roman)
updated = header + \"romanLyrics: |-\\n\" + roman + \"\\n---\\n\" + source
path.write_bytes(updated.encode(\"utf-8\"))
assert path.read_bytes().decode(\"utf-8\").split(\"\\n---\\n\", 1)[1] == source
PY"
